items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I had the pleasure of being in the rhythm section with him in Fletcher's band.

ctx.x: I'm sure you could probably think of a lot -- okay, there are just a couple more here. I'm sure you could probably think of a lot of other people, but you've a number of times mentioned Syd Catlett, Big Syd.

Big Syd Catlett. Yes, I had the pleasure of being in the rhythm section with him in Fletcher's band. And this happened in the Grand Terrace days too, the "Christopher Columbus" era, along with Chu Berry and Roy. Big Syd was a great fellow. He was a take-charge type of fellow,
